forgot.sent: If an account exists, a reset email has been sent.

reset.missingToken: Incomplete link. Request a new email.

reset.doneLead: You can sign in to the console.

verify.title: Email confirmed

verify.leadKey: Your Sandbox API key is shown only once. Copy it now.

env.label: Environment
env.sandboxLead: ky_test_ keys. Deterministic stubs, never billed.
env.liveLead: ky_live_ keys. Real data, debited from organization credit.
env.liveNeedsCredit: A credit balance is required to issue a live key.

home.twoFactor: Two-factor authentication will be required later.
home.keysLead: The secret stays available to copy from the Keys page. Sandbox and live are distinct keys.
home.billingLead: Balance, top-ups, and usage for this organization.
home.platformLead: Open a service to configure it, connect an integration, and read its sandbox and live usage.
home.idvCardLead: Verify an identity remotely, from session to decision.
home.biometricLead: Re-compare an enrolled face. The service page is ready; matching is not yet billed.
home.amlLead: Sanctions, PEPs and adverse media. The service page is ready; screening is not yet billed.

product.sessionsEmptySandbox: No sandbox sessions yet. Create one from this console, or with a ky_test_ key.
product.sessionsEmptyLive: No live sessions this month. A ky_live_ key and sufficient credit are required.
product.sessionsLocked: Your role cannot read verification sessions.
product.settingsLead: Rules for this service. They apply to every integration under it.
product.settingsEnvSandbox: You are viewing sandbox. The rules below also apply to live until they are split.
product.settingsEnvLive: You are viewing live. The rules below also apply to sandbox until they are split.
product.settingsIdentityDecisionBody: Automatic approve / decline / review. Custom profiles arrive with the IDV pipeline.
product.settingsIdentityDocumentsBody: Passport, national ID and driving licence in the published corridor. The list will be editable here.
product.settingsIdentityFlowBody: Consent text and expiry. Organization branding of the applicant flow is not in the MVP.
product.settingsBiometrics: Match threshold and enrollment lifetime will be configured here.
product.settingsAml: Sanctions, PEP and adverse-media lists will be configured here.
product.integrationsLead: Each integration is an API entry point (test or live), with its own keys and later its webhooks. It is not the verification queue.
product.integrationsKeysBodySandbox: ky_test_ keys for this service. Free, no credit debit. The secret is shown only at issuance.
product.integrationsKeysBodyLive: ky_live_ keys for this service. Each resource debits organization credit. A sufficient balance is required. The secret is shown only at issuance.
product.integrationsWebhooksBody: Decision callbacks are signed per integration (HMAC). Media URLs are never included.
product.integrationsUnavailable: This service has no API yet. Keys stay under Identity until it ships.
product.billingNotSold: This service does not debit credit yet.

rules.sourcePlatform: Platform policy. These values apply until a version is published.
rules.readonly: Publishing is reserved for an administrator.
rules.fixedChain: The decision order is fixed. A suspicious indicator stays a review. An unknown document stays a review.
rules.documentsHint: At least one document from the active catalog. An unchecked type is declined on future sessions.
rules.documentsEmpty: No document is published in the catalog.
rules.consentLocked: Version {version}. The text cannot be edited here.
rules.consentFr: Nous allons photographier votre pièce d’identité et votre visage pour vérifier votre identité. Les images sont transmises à l’entreprise qui a ouvert cette session.
rules.consentEn: We will photograph your identity document and your face to verify your identity. The images are sent to the company that opened this session.
rules.confirm: This version applies to future sessions. Links already issued stay unchanged.
rules.loadError: The policy could not be loaded.
rules.errorBelow: Value is below the allowed floor.
rules.errorAbove: Value is above the allowed ceiling.
rules.errorOrder: The face decline threshold must stay below the approval threshold.

webhooks.secretOnce: Copy this secret now — it will not be shown again:
webhooks.readonly: You need API key write permission to configure webhooks.
webhooks.handlerLead: Compute the HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp, a dot, and the raw body, using the whsec_ secret. Return 2xx after you have stored the event.
webhooks.handlerNote: Keep the body raw: do not reformat the JSON before checking the signature.

integrations.lead: Create an integration, copy its key, then create verifications from the Verifications tab.
integrations.name: Name
integrations.nameHint: Required and unique in this organization.
integrations.nameTaken: An integration already has this name.
integrations.liveLocked: Live integrations need a balance of at least one verification. Top up credit first.
integrations.forbidden: Your role cannot create an integration.

install.title: Hosted flow
install.lead: Your application creates the verification session, then opens the hosted flow. The API key stays on your server.
install.fieldsLead: The session is created inside your application, when the user asks to get verified.
install.openLead: Your server creates the session with the API key and returns only hosted_url to the client. The Recogniz-Me plugin opens that URL from the button in your interface.
install.redirectBody: The user leaves your page and continues on the hosted flow.
install.incontextBody: The hosted flow opens in a frame on your page.
install.serverComment: On your server. The API key never reaches the client.
install.keysLink: The API key is on the API keys tab.
install.buttonComment: Your button. The label and the style stay in your interface.

integrations.keysLeadTest: One active ky_test_ key. After revocation, you can issue a new one. The secret stays available to copy here.
integrations.keysLeadLive: One active ky_live_ key. After revocation, you can issue a new one. Each resource debits organization credit. The secret stays available to copy here.

verifications.createLead: Optional fields. A hosted link is issued on create.
verifications.pickIntegrationHint: Test integrations never debit credit. Live integrations do.
verifications.noIntegrations: Create an integration first, then you can start a verification.
verifications.applicantHint: Used to find the session in the list.
verifications.externalIdHint: Your internal identifier, unique in this organization.
verifications.scenarioHint: The sandbox stub applies this outcome after capture.
verifications.emptyHint: Create one from this console, or with a ky_test_ key.
verifications.insufficientCredit: Balance too low for a live verification. Top up credit. Test integrations still work.
verifications.noMedia: The applicant has not sent any capture yet.
verifications.noIdentity: No data has been read from the document yet.
verifications.noChecks: Checks appear once the captures are analysed.
verifications.verdictReviewLead: Review the captures and checks, then approve or decline.
verifications.verdictExpiredLead: The link expired before the flow was completed.
verifications.verdictPendingLead: The applicant has not finished the flow yet.
verifications.verdictProcessingLead: Captures received. The result will be ready shortly.

signalCodes.documentMismatch: Front and back do not match

billing.lead: Balance, top-ups, and usage for this organization.
billing.balanceHint: Drawn down by live usage. Sandbox does not touch the balance.
billing.liveOpenHint: The balance covers at least one live verification.
billing.liveLockedHint: Top up credit to issue a live key.
billing.topupLead: In the MVP, top-ups are by card. Other channels will come later.
billing.topupPackHint: Credit added to the balance after the card payment.
billing.topupOwner: Payment is handled by Stripe. We do not store cards.
billing.topupForbidden: Your role cannot top up credit.
billing.checkoutSuccess: Payment received. The balance updates once Stripe confirms.
billing.checkoutCancel: Payment cancelled. No credit was added.
billing.consumptionLead: What drew down the credit, per service. This is not an invoice: collection is the balance above.
billing.provisional: Amounts are fixed: $0.90 per live verification, top-ups $50 / $100 / $250 / $500.
